persona: Denis - Norwegian national (EEA), Oslo to Paris repatriation

resources.title: EEA driving licence recognition in France (no exchange required while valid)
resources.note: A valid Norwegian EEA licence may be used to drive in France without exchange; exchange only becomes necessary on expiry, loss/theft, or after a French offence affecting the licence.

resources.title: Optional exchange of a foreign licence for a French permit (ANTS online procedure)
resources.source_authority: ANTS - Agence nationale des titres securises
resources.note: Exchange is optional for an EEA licence while valid. Application is online via ANTS; expect a multi-month processing time and a small fee for issuance of the French title.

resources.title: Conditions and deadlines to exchange an EU/EEA licence in France
resources.note: Explains when an EEA licence holder resident in France must or may exchange (e.g. expiry, points/penalty events, need for a French photocard).

resources.title: Driving licence categories (B, BE, C, ...) and EEA equivalence
resources.note: EEA licence categories are harmonised; Norwegian categories B, BE, C etc. map to the equivalent French categories.

resources.title: Lost or stolen foreign licence while resident in France
resources.note: If a Norwegian licence is lost or stolen in France, a French replacement is generally obtained via ANTS rather than reissue from Norway, since the holder is resident in France.

resources.title: International Driving Permit - not required within the EEA, useful for third countries
resources.note: An IDP is not needed to drive in France with a Norwegian EEA licence, but can be useful when driving in non-EEA third countries.

resources.title: Renewing or replacing a Norwegian driving licence (Statens vegvesen)
resources.source_authority: Statens vegvesen - Norwegian Public Roads Administration
resources.note: Because renewing an EEA licence from abroad is difficult, the holder should keep the Norwegian licence valid; renewal/replacement is handled by Statens vegvesen.
